dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, linear white-to-light-grey boundaries along the outer edges of folded primaries and tertials.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse transition; demarcation is characterized by a shift from fine dark longitudinal streaks on the crown to broad, pale-fringed scalloping on the mantle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, circular white marking is present on the dorsal surface of the right-center tail feathers.
